program.name: Nooner
program.subject: Quickie
program.blurb: A lunchtime quickie: an AMRAP or a strength block, a finisher, and back at your desk by one.
program.about: Midday, quick, and dirty enough to leave you half hard thinking about her. An AMRAP of swings, presses and squats with a core finisher one day; a short strength superset with a Tabata after the other. Back to work with a grin. Level II adds reps, Level III asks for heavier weights.
